evidence.quote: The public repair stand goes by the river path entrance

observations.why: Present-tense assertion about the actual, specific placement of a named artifact; no hedging or hypothetical framing.

evidence.quote: Put the pump on a chain
the last one walked off in a week

observations.why: Imperative directive aims at a future action on a particular pump (irrealis, concrete); the past-tense clause supplies the warrant, so past focus is present but subordinate to the forward-looking instruction.
